You are a planning expert. Given an asynchronous planning problem, extract the dependency graph.

For each step, identify:
1. A short snake_case name (e.g., "boil_water", "add_pasta") — use ONLY lowercase letters, digits, and underscores
2. The duration in SECONDS (convert minutes/hours/days if needed: 1 min=60s, 1 hour=3600s, 1 day=86400s)
3. The DIRECT predecessors — steps that MUST complete before this step can start

CRITICAL RULES:
- List ALL direct predecessor steps in "depends_on". A missing dependency will cause a wrong answer.
- If a step has no prerequisites, use an empty list [].
- Every name in "depends_on" MUST exactly match a "name" defined in the same "steps" list.
- Capture ONLY dependencies stated in the problem. Do NOT add extra constraints.

SELF-CHECK before returning:
1. Re-read EVERY ordering constraint in the problem. Is each one captured in some step's "depends_on"?
2. For every entry in any "depends_on" list, confirm that exact name appears as a "name" in the steps list.

Return JSON with key "responses" (list of dicts). Each dict must have key "steps" (list of step dicts).
Each step dict must include:
- "name": snake_case string identifier
- "duration": integer seconds
- "depends_on": list of step name strings (direct predecessors only)

Example:
{
  "responses": [{
    "steps": [
      {"name": "boil_water",  "duration": 300,  "depends_on": []},
      {"name": "add_pasta",   "duration": 600,  "depends_on": ["boil_water"]},
      {"name": "make_sauce",  "duration": 900,  "depends_on": []},
      {"name": "combine",     "duration": 60,   "depends_on": ["add_pasta", "make_sauce"]}
    ]
  }]
}

Here is an asynchronous planning problem.

To make leche flan, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Separate the egg yolks from the whites (300 seconds)
Step 2. Whisk the egg yolks gently in a circular motion (180 seconds)
Step 3. Slowly pour the condensed milk into the yolks (120 seconds)
Step 4. Add the evaporated milk to the mixture (120 seconds)
Step 5. Stir in a teaspoon of vanilla extract (30 seconds)
Step 6. Grate some fresh lemon zest (240 seconds)
Step 7. Add the lemon zest to the custard base (60 seconds)
Step 8. Melt white sugar in a heavy-bottomed pan (600 seconds)
Step 9. Stir the sugar constantly to prevent burning (480 seconds)
Step 10. Wait for the sugar to reach a golden amber color (300 seconds)
Step 11. Pour the caramelized sugar into the llaneras (120 seconds)
Step 12. Tilt the llaneras to coat the bottom evenly (180 seconds)
Step 13. Let the caramel cool and harden (600 seconds)
Step 14. Strain the custard mixture through a fine mesh sieve (240 seconds)
Step 15. Repeat the straining process for a smoother texture (240 seconds)
Step 16. Tap the llaneras on the counter to release air bubbles (120 seconds)
Step 17. Cover each llanera tightly with aluminum foil (180 seconds)
Step 18. Prepare the steamer by adding water to the bottom (120 seconds)
Step 19. Place the steamer rack inside the pot (30 seconds)
Step 20. Bring the steamer water to a gentle boil (420 seconds)
Step 21. Lower the heat to maintain a simmer (120 seconds)
Step 22. Carefully place the llaneras inside the steamer (180 seconds)
Step 23. Steam the flan on low heat (2700 seconds)
Step 24. Check the water level in the steamer (60 seconds)
Step 25. Check the firmness of the custard with a toothpick (120 seconds)
Step 26. Remove the llaneras from the steamer (300 seconds)
Step 27. Let the flan cool to room temperature (3600 seconds)
Step 28. Refrigerate the flan to set completely (14400 seconds)
Step 29. Prepare a serving platter (120 seconds)
Step 30. Run a thin knife around the edges of the llanera (120 seconds)
Step 31. Invert the llanera onto the platter (60 seconds)
Step 32. Tap the bottom of the llanera to release the flan (30 seconds)
Step 33. Lift the llanera slowly to reveal the caramel glaze (30 seconds)
Step 34. Wipe any spills from the edges of the platter (60 seconds)
Step 35. Slice the leche flan into serving portions (120 seconds)
Step 36. Garnish with a sprig of mint (60 seconds)
Step 37. Whip some heavy cream for a topping (360 seconds)
Step 38. Add a dollop of whipped cream to each slice (120 seconds)
Step 39. Sprinkle a pinch of sea salt over the caramel (30 seconds)
Step 40. Prepare individual dessert plates (180 seconds)
Step 41. Place a slice on each dessert plate (120 seconds)
Step 42. Drizzle extra caramel syrup from the pan (60 seconds)
Step 43. Clean the mixing bowls (600 seconds)
Step 44. Wash the fine mesh sieve (300 seconds)
Step 45. Soak the caramelized pan in hot water (1200 seconds)
Step 46. Scrub the hardened sugar off the pan (480 seconds)
Step 47. Dry all the used utensils (300 seconds)
Step 48. Put away the unused egg whites (120 seconds)
Step 49. Organize the spice cabinet (900 seconds)
Step 50. Take a photo of the finished dessert (180 seconds)
Step 51. Share the photo on social media (120 seconds)
Step 52. Write down any adjustments for the next batch (300 seconds)
Step 53. Preheat the oven for an alternate water bath method (600 seconds)
Step 54. Prepare a large roasting pan (180 seconds)
Step 55. Fill the roasting pan with hot water (120 seconds)
Step 56. Place the llaneras inside the roasting pan (120 seconds)
Step 57. Bake the custard at a low temperature (3600 seconds)
Step 58. Check the internal temperature of the oven (60 seconds)
Step 59. Rotate the pan halfway through baking (60 seconds)
Step 60. Remove the pan from the oven carefully (180 seconds)
Step 61. Let the water bath cool down (1800 seconds)
Step 62. Discard the water from the roasting pan (120 seconds)
Step 63. Wipe the condensation off the foil covers (120 seconds)
Step 64. Label the llaneras with the date (60 seconds)
Step 65. Clear space in the refrigerator (300 seconds)
Step 66. Stack the llaneras carefully in the fridge (120 seconds)
Step 67. Check the refrigerator temperature setting (60 seconds)
Step 68. Prepare a shopping list for more ingredients (300 seconds)
Step 69. Clean the kitchen countertops (600 seconds)
Step 70. Sweep the kitchen floor (420 seconds)
Step 71. Mop the kitchen floor (720 seconds)
Step 72. Take out the kitchen trash (300 seconds)
Step 73. Recycle the empty milk cans (120 seconds)
Step 74. Compost the eggshells (60 seconds)
Step 75. Hand wash the delicate serving platter (240 seconds)
Step 76. Polish the dessert spoons (600 seconds)
Step 77. Set the dining table (480 seconds)
Step 78. Fold linen napkins (300 seconds)
Step 79. Light a scented candle (60 seconds)
Step 80. Brew a pot of coffee to accompany the flan (360 seconds)
Step 81. Select a dessert wine (120 seconds)
Step 82. Chill the dessert wine (1200 seconds)
Step 83. Open the wine bottle (60 seconds)
Step 84. Pour the wine into glasses (120 seconds)
Step 85. Call the family to the table (60 seconds)
Step 86. Describe the dessert to the guests (120 seconds)
Step 87. Serve the first portion (60 seconds)
Step 88. Enjoy the first bite (60 seconds)
Step 89. Discuss the texture and flavor (300 seconds)
Step 90. Offer second helpings (120 seconds)
Step 91. Clear the table after eating (600 seconds)
Step 92. Load the dishwasher (720 seconds)
Step 93. Run the dishwasher cycle (7200 seconds)
Step 94. Hand dry the crystal glasses (600 seconds)
Step 95. Put the llaneras back in the cupboard (180 seconds)
Step 96. Store the leftover flan in a container (180 seconds)
Step 97. Wipe the dining table (240 seconds)
Step 98. Blow out the candle (10 seconds)
Step 99. Turn off the kitchen lights (10 seconds)
Step 100. Review the recipe for improvements (600 seconds)
